essence: Therefore the wise practitioner should worship Viṣṇu with the world-guardians arranged outside.
Therefore the worshipper must first invoke and worship with fragrances and other offerings, beginning with the joining of channels.
Therefore one should perform the full offering using fuel-sticks, clarified butter, food, parched grains, and sesame seeds.
Therefore the best twice-born may participate if they have previously been consecrated by the stated method.
Therefore worship of the teacher should be performed especially at the beginning of the dance.
